title: potentilla hirta var. laeta
intro: Potentilla hirta var. laeta, commonly known as five-leaved potentilla, is a plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae) and is native to the mountainous regions of Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues, inflammation, and fever, as well as having antioxidant and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla hirta var. laeta include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antiseptic actions, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
